subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-discovery of agent configurations from external workspaces

question: Should OpenClaw add core trusted workspace-agent discovery, or keep agent registration explicit and solve the pain through safer runtime registration/reload APIs?
rationale: The request adds new config, filesystem scanning, trust boundaries, and live routing/session semantics that cannot be chosen safely by repair automation.

options.title: Keep Explicit Registration
options.body: Continue using central config and `agents.create/update/delete` while treating external discovery as operator tooling unless a smaller missing API is identified.

options.title: Design Trusted Discovery
options.body: Define a core discovery contract with trusted roots, precedence rules, validation, reload semantics, and security proof before implementation.

options.title: Prioritize Zero-Restart Agent Management
options.body: Defer glob discovery and first design live explicit agent registration so manual `agents add` stops requiring disruptive restart behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Registration
recommendation.body: Continue using central config and `agents.create/update/delete` while treating external discovery as operator tooling unless a smaller missing API is identified.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent source-history signal across agent config/schema and gateway agent-management paths.
